test_mujoco_bindings_simulation: test the MuJoCo Python bindings for loading XML models, stepping simulation, and accessing physics data
test_mujoco_named_indexing: test the MuJoCo named indexing API for accessing model and data elements by name or integer index
test_mujoco_pickle_serialization: test the MuJoCo MjModel and MjData objects can be pickled and unpickled with all attributes preserved
test_mujoco_callback_system: test the MuJoCo callback system for mjcb_time, mjcb_sensor, and mjcb_control with exception handling
test_mujoco_math_functions: test the MuJoCo low-level math functions including quaternion operations, ray-geom intersection, and banded matrix operations
